_comment: Branch protection policy for main. Applied via scripts/apply-branch-protection.sh. See docs/dev/branch-protection.md for rationale. .github/CODEOWNERS is advisory: it requests reviewers per workspace member, but require_code_owner_reviews stays false and no approvals are required, so the required PR checks below are the gate. Graph Vocabulary Guard currently reports a successful PR skip while its full audit runs post-merge, on tags, and by manual dispatch. The full workspace suite is a required context on pull requests and on the merge queue's branch (fail-fast there; it adds queue latency only where it outruns the other required contexts of the same entry); the format fence and the RustFS S3 suite run on pull requests as reporting contexts and again after merge; the Azurite suite runs post-merge; immutable workflow refs are checked on every run. A red main branch is stop-the-line until fixed or reverted. Storage Upgrade Compatibility is a required context on every change, including documentation-only pull requests. Dependency Guard (cargo deny) is required on every change; its RustSec database is fetched at run time, so a new advisory reds every open pull request until a lockfile bump or a deny.toml exemption lands on main. Every merge into main goes through the merge queue with the squash method; the branch-protection endpoint this script drives has no field for the queue, so it is set on the rule page and checked there after every apply. Each required context's workflow also runs on merge_group (scripts/check-merge-group-triggers.py enforces it); Fix Regression Gate's merge-group run reports a pass without a check. No administrator bypass: enforce_admins is true.
